nodes.label: sync workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs `pnpm sync` daily at 13:30 UTC with DATABASE_URL and TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY; the only path that refreshes holdings, FX, EOD prices and NAVs.

nodes.label: Daily-not-weekday sync cron, after NSE publication
nodes.rationale: A weekday-only sync left the Monday 03:15 digest reading Friday's data — 63.25h against a 36h freshness limit — so one digest in five was a guaranteed false staleness alarm. The band was right; the schedule was wrong. 19:00 IST = 13:30 UTC because NSE's whole-market file only lands after ~18:00 IST; an earlier run 404s it and prices_eod stays empty.

nodes.label: packageManager as the single pnpm version source
nodes.rationale: No workflow pins `version:` on pnpm/action-setup — package.json's `packageManager` is authoritative. Specifying both makes the action fail with 'Multiple versions of pnpm specified', which would break every workflow at setup.
